mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (lesson_id, title, description) VALUES (#{lessonId}, #{title}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT id, lesson_id, title, description FROM tasks WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_files WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.original_name, f.content_type FROM course_files f JOIN task_files link ON link.file_id = f.id WHERE link.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY f.id
